answer: A raven of per-task receipts records who did what, and the basalt of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the pigment of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
